title: Geniculated
summary: GENIC'ULATED, adjective [Latin geniculatus, from geniculum, a knot or joint, from the root of genu, the knee. See Knee.] Kneed; knee-jointed; having joints like the knee a little bent; as a geniculate

inlines.v: GENIC'ULATED, adjective [Latin geniculatus, from geniculum, a knot or joint, from the root of genu, the knee. See Knee.] Kneed; knee-jointed; having joints like the knee a little bent; as a geniculated stem or peduncle.
